acceptance: Each defect has a red-first test
The binary guard's refusals are pinned by a Run-level test (the moved guard is unpinned today)

consumed.resolution: Attestation.Marshal encodes every value with encoding/json (layout unchanged); laneNode skips files deleted from the working tree; a failing gofmt now fails the Go lane (checkGofmt); changedFiles runs under Run's ctx; the binary guard's refusal and fault are pinned through Run. Each with a red-first test in go/internal/commitgate.

fix: Marshal with encoding/json; skip deleted files in laneNode; treat a gofmt failure as a lane failure; thread ctx.
source: console, 2026-09-30, comment round 12 editors and reviewers (PR #749)
summary: Found by round 12's editor: the attestation's Marshal writes reviewers_run through jsonStringArray without JSON escaping, so a reviewer name with a quote writes invalid JSON (attestation.go); laneNode passes deleted .ts/.js files to eslint (lanes.go); the gofmt lane counts a failing gofmt run (parse error, missing binary) as formatted and records go:gofmt (lanes.go); changedFiles runs git diff under context.Background instead of Run's ctx (commitgate.go).
title: commitgate writes reviewers_run unescaped, lints deleted TS files, counts a failing gofmt as formatted, and ignores Run's context
